subject: Request: employee training / background-check evidence for SIG review
messages:
From: AudIT Partners <audits@auditpartners.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-15T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG - request for employee vetting & training evidence

Hi Lauren,

We're running the SIG review for Acme Corp and need sample evidence around Redwood's personnel controls. Specifically we are requesting:

- Training records (security awareness, data handling) for a random sample of 5 new hires from the last 12 months (completion date + course id).
- Proof of background checks (vendor attestation + sample redacted reports).
- Offboarding evidence: last 6 months of access revocations (screenshot or export) and an example leaver ticket with timestamps.
- Any documented exceptions or contractors lacking background checks and the remediation plan.

Preferred delivery: CSV for logs and PDF for attestations. Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow whether you can provide these artifacts and the delivery mechanism (SFTP/link)? Also include the HubSpot ticket ID if you track requests.

Thanks,
Tom Harris
Audit Manager, AudIT Partners
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: AudIT Partners <audits@auditpartners.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG - request for employee vetting & training evidence

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We're able to compile the sample artifacts you requested. Quick clarifications:

- For the training records: we can provide a redacted CSV export (employee id, hire date, course id, completion timestamp). We typically keep training completion records in Lattice and export to CSV.
- Background checks: our vendor is Checkr; we can provide the attestation PDF and redacted sample reports.
- Offboarding: we can export access-revocations from our IdP (Okta) as CSV and include the corresponding ticket from our internal tracker.

We will produce a redacted package and share via a secure Google Drive folder (we can also SFTP if you prefer). HubSpot ticket HS-91234 will be attached in our notes.

I am looping in Marissa (security ops) and Karthik (people ops) to assemble the artifacts. Expect an initial upload by end of day Wednesday.

— Lauren Bishop
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG - request for employee vetting & training evidence

Marissa —

Received, thank you for the bundle. A few follow-ups after a quick review:

1) For the training CSV: please include the course identifier (Lattice course slug) and the training version where possible.
2) For the background checks: the Checkr attestation is fine, but we also need a statement on retention period for raw background reports and where they are stored (encrypted S3, etc.).
3) We noted one exception: an individual listed as a "contractor" in the sample did not have a completed background check in the records provided. Please provide the remediation plan and dates for that case (was access ever removed?).

Can you provide the extra fields and the remediation evidence (access removal ticket or confirmation) by COB Friday? Otherwise we will note an open exception in the SIG report.

Best,
Tom Harris
AudIT Partners
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: AudIT Partners <audits@auditpartners.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-18T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG - request for employee vetting & training evidence

Tom —

Thank you — quick update and remediation attachments included.

Actions taken (contractor exception):
- Access removed the same day we discovered the missing background check (Okta deprovision record attached).
- Offboarding ticket created: OPS-1457 (see offboarding-sample-timeline.pdf) with timestamps showing manager approval for removal.
- Short-term mitigation: contractor's access to production S3 was revoked and an audit of recent activity was run (no anomalies found).
- Long-term: People Ops is updating the onboarding checklist to gate contractor provisioning until Checkr completes checks; target rollout: 2027-07-01.

Attachments added to drive: access-revocations-20270618.csv (Okta export). HubSpot reference: HS-91234.

If you'd like an encrypted bundle or DocuSign attestation for the vendor files, we can provide that as well.

— Lauren Bishop
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
